audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Kennen levels 2, 3 and 6 and the 2+ item stage, while the whys directly under it say 'the lane starts tipping your way' at 2, 'punish his poke cooldowns' at 3, 'Level 6 stays yours in a straight 1v1' and 'At 2+ items it's a skill standoff'. The packet chart is Kennen, then Illaoi x4, then Skill, Skill. diffRating 8.5/10 also contradicts diff EVEN and a 49.61% win rate.
audit.why: Both layers agreed with each other but disagreed with the packet and with their own prose, so the page rated the lane hard-losing while telling the reader they win the middle of it.
audit.corrected: Rows 2-5 -> Illaoi, Level 6 -> Illaoi, 2+ items -> Skill, in both layers. Level 1 stays Kennen. diffRating 8.5/10 -> 6/10 with the difficulty prose to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: Lightning Rush was described only as 'his escape' with no numbers, and its 170 range was never mentioned.
audit.why: Lightning Rush is 10/9/8/7/6s and only 170 range — it is a short reposition, not a Riftwalk. Thundering Shuriken drops from 7s to 4s as it ranks, so his poke window shortens while your Test of Spirit stays 16/15/14/13/12s.
audit.corrected: Real cooldown and range written into the do's; spike ordering left as-is because it already matches the corrected chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mark of the Storm's three-stack stun was named only as 'get triple-stunned' with no explanation of which abilities stack it, and Electrical Surge's on-hit was absent entirely.
audit.why: Q, W and E each apply a Mark of the Storm, so his full rotation stuns on its own — no ally needed. Electrical Surge applies on-hit and scales with attack speed, so armour reads his trade wrong; MR is the stat.
audit.corrected: Three-mark stun spelled out in the don'ts; on-hit/MR written into the key-interactions block.

edits.before: His escape. E him when it’s down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Lightning Rush is 10s at rank 1 and only 170 range — step in on it.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Three Marks of the Storm stun you — Q, W and E each stack one.

edits.before: Track Kennen's Lightning Rush: His escape. E him when it’s down. When it is down — Slam him in your field.
edits.after: Three Marks of the Storm stun; Electrical Surge applies on-hit, so buy MR, not armour, before extended trades.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 8.5/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Lightning Rush and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 6/10. He owns level 1, you own levels 2-5, and from your first item on it is decided by who lands first.

edits.before: Hard matchup — difficulty 8.5/10, Kennen carry threat 8.5/10.
edits.after: Even matchup — difficulty 6/10, Kennen carry threat 8.5/10.
